description: Use this when your user decided to quote: it builds the kit their person needs to submit, ready for one last click in Mercado Público (Andes cannot submit it). Pass tender_id and the prices: unit_prices per line ([{"line": 1, "unit_price": 12500}], net unless prices_include_vat) or quote_total (VAT included); optionally delivery_days and supplier_id (the user's RUT). Returns the requested lines with the draft (net, IVA 19%, total), readiness checks with their evidence (open, registered supplier, within the buyer's budget, quotes received and their range, delivery, documents to attach), the deadline and the link to submit. It never invents prices: unpriced lines stay unpriced. Any identified agent can call it. If the person you act for approved an AndesPass mandate for procurement.quote.prepare with a ceiling covering the total, the kit says it was prepared under that mandate and the call leaves a signed receipt; without one it is a draft for your person to review. Access: needs an identified agent key (free, self-service at https://pass.andesprotocol.com).
name: prepare_quote
title: Prepare a quote
